title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Pluviometer
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Pluviometer. A sensor that measures the rain fall. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here). The ttl declares no own owl:Restriction beyond the subclassing; per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent, the generic saref:Sensor vocabulary it inherits (saref:measuresProperty, saref:hasValue, saref:makesMeasurement, saref:hasFunction, etc.) is documented here rather than repeated structurally. `observes`, `value`, `unitCode` and `dateObserved` are added as common Smart Data Models sensor-observation convenience attributes (not individually declared as their own owl:Restriction on Pluviometer), following the saref:observes / saref:hasValue / saref:isMeasuredIn pattern shown for other SAREF4AGRI sensors in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Pluviometer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

observes.description: Property/Relationship. saref:observes. The s4agri:Property named individual this sensor measures: 'the amount of water falling in the soil by natural process (e.g. rain)'. IRI: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Precipitation.

value.description: Property. saref:hasValue. The last rainfall measurement reported by the sensor.

unitCode.description: Property. saref:isMeasuredIn. The unit of measure for 'value' (e.g. 'MMT' millimetre).

dateObserved.description: Property. The date and time this measurement was made.

isSubSystemOf.description: Relationship. ssn:hasSubSystem (inverse). The System (e.g. a WeatherStation) this sensor is a component/subsystem of, if any.
